_comment: The exposure gate's arm (docs/exposure_evaluator_prereg_20261012.md; scripts/lookahead_gate_box.sh): the material gate's configuration (configs/lookahead_material_gate.json: k 8, c 1, sigma 0.1, every decision kind, the observed world) with the material_exposure evaluator (wesnoth_ai/lookahead_exposure.py): tanh(M / scale), M the deciding side's material in gold (cost x hp / max_hp per unit, plus gold, own less the opponent's) less the expected material the opponent's units can take on its next turn. scale: a placeholder the box replaces before the match by the median |M| over the states its 50 timed decisions valued (tools/lookahead_gate.py calibrate, calibrate_scale); 20 is that median rounded on the laptop's 20 timed decisions of 2026-10-12 (18.0 over 262 states).
